headline: Saudi Arabia Revises 2026 GDP Forecast to 2.1% Contraction as Oil Exports Rise
summary: Saudi Arabia announced in its budget statement that it expects its economy to shrink by 2.1% this year, an improvement from its previous 3.6% contraction forecast, as crude oil exports recovered.
why: Saudi Arabia is the largest crude oil exporter in the world and the biggest economy in the Middle East.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia Economy
impacts.why: Recovering crude exports reduced the expected economic contraction for the year.
